criteria.requirement: Repair rows_from_file automatic CSV dialect detection to consider explicit common delimiters comma/tab/semicolon/pipe, not arbitrary repeated letters in URLs or names. If sniffing fails and no candidate delimiter appears, treat as single CSV column with normal header/rows; preserve Unicode, header-only and ordinary multi-column files. Existing explicit format/dialect and CLI explicit --sniff semantics remain unchanged. If candidate separators are present but inconsistent, do not silently downgrade malformed multicolumn data. Real row dicts must match input, not only format labels.
